LESSON: DRAWING AND PAINTING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: CREATING AND PERFORMING IN CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS Strand Sub Strand Specific L
Topic 2.1: Drawing and Painting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Drawing and Painting
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can balance be achieved in a drawing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain balance in a picture
2. draw a picture to apply balance
3. appreciate own and others' pictorial composition

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain balance in a picture

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain balance in a picture.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain balance in a picture” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain balance in a picture” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain balance in a picture" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: draw a picture to apply balance

Teach
• Today’s focus: draw a picture to apply balance.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model A for “draw a picture to apply balance” using a school example.
• Model B for “draw a picture to apply balance” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "draw a picture to apply balance" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: appreciate own and others' pictorial composition

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate own and others' pictorial composition.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “appreciate own and others' pictorial composition” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate own and others' pictorial composition" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain balance in a picture
• Model 2: draw a picture to apply balance
• Model 3: appreciate own and others' pictorial composition

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain balance in a picture
2. Practise: draw a picture to apply balance
3. Practise: appreciate own and others' pictorial composition

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Drawing and Painting.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can balance be achieved in a drawing?
2. What emotions do different colours evoke in us when we look at them?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain balance in a picture
• draw a picture to apply balance
• appreciate own and others' pictorial composition

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
